# Paddle

Paddle is the Merchant of Record that empowers digital product companies to operate and grow, automatically.

[security@paddle.com](mailto:security@paddle.com)

[Privacy Policy](https://www.paddle.com/legal/privacy) Opens in new tab

Welcome to Paddle's Trust Center. Our commitment to data privacy and security is embedded in every part of our business. We take the security of our platform and our customers' data seriously. Use this portal to learn about our security posture and request full access to our security documentation.

We aspire to be transparent with our customers and prospects on the current state of the security and privacy program and the security controls implemented on the platform you rely on. The more information we can put at your fingertips, the less time and effort you will expend asking us to give you the information you need.

This portal provides an overview of the controls and policies implemented across Paddle the enterprise, as well as across the SaaS platform. Where possible, we include the documents in support of the information provided.

Email us at the address listed above if you have any additional questions not answered by the information provided in this site or spot any errors. We are human and they do happen!

### Trust Center update: We’ve moved to a new home

Published January 28, 2026

We’ve migrated our Trust Center experience to Vanta to make it easier for customers to access our security and compliance information.

* * *

#### What’s changing

- Our previous Trust Center hosted at `security.paddle.com` has been retired.
- Our new Trust Center is now available at: [`trust.paddle.com`](https://trust.paddle.com/) Opens in new tab

#### What if I use the old link?

If you visit `security.paddle.com`, you’ll be automatically redirected to `trust.paddle.com` to help ensure continuity and avoid broken bookmarks.
